These plans appeared in the magazine Popular Mechanics so that anybody could make the board out of wood themselves, furthering the awareness of the popularity of surfing at the time.

Dress Gordon
Dress Gordon is one of Scotland’s traditional tartan patterns, associated with the Gordon clan. Originating as the dress version of the Gordon tartan from the Scottish Lowlands, it was historically used in dresses worn by women attending social gatherings and became favored among the aristocracy. Its refreshing design features a white base with broad navy and green checks accented by fine yellow lines, creating an elegant and distinctive appearance.
